title: Child-safety gate: plural anatomy words and chastity/pulled-aside wording skip the picture check
description: A picture the describer would flag as a possible minor is never looked at when the words ask for nudity in forms the lists miss: plural 'penises', 'chastity cage', 'bottom pulled aside to expose'. Found from a user refusal 2026-10-22 that only fired because the prompt also said 'bikini'. Widen SEXUAL/UNCLOTHED (plurals of the anatomy nouns, chastity devices, clothing pulled aside), regression tests in tests/child-safety.test.cjs.
